صِنَّارَةٌ : see صِنَّارٌ. ―
-b2- Also The handle of the [kind of shield called] حَجَفَة: (S, K:) pl. صَنَانِيرُ. (K.) ―
-b3- And The ear: (S, M, K:) of the dial. of El-Yemen. (S, M.) ＝
-A2- Also A man evil in disposition; (M, K;) on the authority of IAar; (M;) as also ↓ صَنَّارَةٌ ; (M, K;) on the authority of Kr: Aboo-'Alee says that the former has this meaning; but it is not of the form of words mentioned in the Book [of Sb], because [it is said that] this form does not occur as an epithet. (M.) And the former, (K, TA,) accord. to IAar, (TA,) Bad in respect of أّدَب [or discipline of the mind and manners, &c.], even though eminent, or celebrated, or well known: (K, TA:) pl. as above. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
